## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and vendor-neutral.
- [ ] Normative claims are distinguishable from explanatory material.
- [ ] JSON examples validate against the applicable schema.
- [ ] Mermaid source passes the repository lint process.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, customer data, or proprietary prompts are included.
- [ ] The changelog is updated if meaning or behavior changes.
